about: The words the partners page delete box uses for each table a partner delete touches or is refused by (#2140). One entry per table public.partner_delete_dependents() returns: the Worker labels the delete check from this file (lib/partner-delete.ts), and supabase/tests/partner_delete.test.sql reads it from the SQL suite container and fails on a dependent with no entry, or an entry for a table that is no longer a dependent. one and many are the noun for a count of 1 and for any other count.
